sens_en: to hold in the mouth, to contain
origine_fr: 今 au-dessus de la bouche 口. 含, c'est tenir dans la bouche, et 今 donnait le son, mais il se lit jīn, loin de hán. Garder en bouche sans avaler : contenir.
origine_en: 今 above the mouth 口. 含 is holding in the mouth, and 今 gave the sound, but it reads jīn, far from hán. Keeping something in the mouth without swallowing: to contain.

phrase.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ hányǒu hěn duō táng.
phrase.fr: Ce fruit contient beaucoup de sucre.
phrase.en: This fruit contains a lot of sugar.
